decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly deploying efficient threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic, burn spells, and land destruction. The key strategy is to control the tempo of the game by applying pressure with creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent while using cards like Daze, Force of Will, and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's plays. By maintaining a fast, aggressive pace and staying ahead on board presence, the deck aims to close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly combo off by using cards like Undercity Informer, Balustrade Spy, and Thassa's Oracle to quickly mill our library and win the game. The deck runs a lot of fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to accelerate the combo. It also includes protection in the form of Pact of Negation and Thoughtseize to ensure that the combo goes off successfully. The inclusion of Agadeem's Awakening and Turntimber Symbiosis provide additional utility in finding combo pieces or protecting key creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to maintain tempo and pressure by playing efficient threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes a suite of disruptive spells such as Force of Will, Daze, and Lightning Bolt to control the board and protect its threats. Utilizing cantrips like Brainstorm, Expressive Iteration, and Ponder helps to dig for key cards and ensure smooth draws. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while effectively deploying threats to win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the game tempo by efficiently utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble, Gut Shot, and Daze to disrupt the opponent's strategy. This allows the deck to quickly deploy threats such as Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while also maintaining card advantage with Expressive Iteration, Ponder, and Brainstorm. With a mix of powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and disruptive counterspells like Force of Will, the deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponent's strategies with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Sanctum Prelate while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Skyclave Apparition. Aether Vial allows for instant-speed creature deployment, making it difficult for the opponent to predict or counter your plays. Mana denial is also a key aspect of the deck, with cards like Rishadan Port and Wasteland aimed at disrupting the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to control the game tempo while chipping away at the opponent's life total with a combination of disruptive creatures and efficient equipment.

This deck focuses on utilizing disruptive creatures and removal spells to control the opponent's board while also deploying threats of its own. By using cards like Mother of Runes and Stoneforge Mystic to protect key creatures and equipment, the deck aims to outvalue opponents by generating incremental advantages. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion provides additional value by blinking creatures and triggering powerful enter the battlefield effects. Through a combination of disruption, card advantage, and efficient threats, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its aggressive game plan.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize lands as both a source of control and as a win condition. By leveraging cards like Crucible of Worlds, Life from the Loam, and Exploration, the deck aims to consistently generate value from its lands while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Wasteland and Ghost Quarter. The deck's win condition primarily revolves around assembling the Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage combo, allowing it to create a powerful 20/20 Marit Lage token. The inclusion of cards like Sphere of Resistance also helps to slow down the opponent, giving the deck time to establish its dominant position on the battlefield.

The deck aims to assemble the two-card combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token with indestructible. It has multiple ways to tutor for the combo pieces such as Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith. The Land toolbox strategy is supported by cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer, while disruption and removal options like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending help control the opponent's game plan. The deck also has a solid card advantage engine with Sylvan Library and the flexibility to adapt to different situations.

The primary concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. By utilizing disruptive elements like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth, the deck aims to slow down the opponent while efficiently deploying threats like Stoneforge Mystic and Skyclave Apparition. With Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play and powerful equipment like Sword of Fire and Ice, the deck can quickly close out games. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in longer games.

Focused on disrupting opponents through taxing effects and aggressive creatures, this Death & Taxes deck aims to control the game with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth while also applying pressure with creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Flickerwisp. By utilizing the Aether Vial to cheat out creatures and powerful equipment like Batterskull and Umezawa's Jitte, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents. Additionally, cards like Sanctum Prelate and Solitude provide additional disruption and removal options, making it difficult for opponents to execute their game plan.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent by playing aggressive goblin creatures and utilizing cards like Aether Vial to quickly get them onto the battlefield. The deck is focused on using efficient creatures like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to search for key pieces like Muxus, Goblin Grandee, and Sling-Gang Lieutenant. With disruption cards like Munitions Expert and Masked Vandal, as well as land destruction from Rishadan Port and Wasteland, the deck aims to control the board while also dealing consistent damage to the opponent.

The deck focuses on playing aggressively while keeping control of the game through efficient removal and disruptive spells. By utilizing cheap and powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with strong card selection and disruption spells like Brainstorm and Force of Will, the deck aims to apply pressure on opponents while disrupting their game plan. With a mix of countermagic, removal, and threats, the deck seeks to win through quick and consistent damage output while maintaining control of the battlefield.

The deck focuses on a combination of controlling the board with lands and using various exploration effects to generate card advantage. By utilizing cards like Crop Rotation, Urza's Saga, and Valakut Exploration, the deck aims to grind out value over time while locking down the opponent's resources with cards like Ghost Quarter and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale. The deck also has a combo finish with Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage, allowing for a quick win if the opportunity arises. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through resource denial and incremental advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control of the battlefield while applying pressure to the opponent through aggressive plays. This is achieved by utilizing cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's strategy, coupled with powerful creatures like Monastery Mentor and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to further control the tempo of the game. Overall, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent by efficiently utilizing its resources and disrupting their game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain a fast tempo by playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while using spells like Brainstorm, Daze, and Force of Will to control the game and protect your creatures. The deck also utilizes cards like Lightning Bolt for removal and Ponder for consistent card draw. With a mana base focused on efficient lands like Wasteland and Volcanic Island, the deck aims to quickly apply pressure on the opponent and disrupt their game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan through counter spells and removal. By utilizing efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with a suite of cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Daze, this deck aims to control the game tempo and come out ahead in the early game. The mana base consists of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.
